patch_description: This replaces neighborhood-by-neighborhood local search with an evolutionary edge-inheritance strategy. It builds a diverse archive of LP-scored networks, combines pairs by importing donor links through degree-preserving switches, and uses the surrogate energy to screen offspring before spending an LP call. Occasional random switch mutations help explore beyond the candidate pool; dual prices provide a secondary guide for which parent links to remove. This aims to search across combinations of good networks rather than repeatedly optimizing one parent’s local neighborhood.
